authority: User instructions and answers in this conversation

portfolio.note: Personal wallet addresses and allocation details removed for public publication.

horizon_origin: Scenario start timestamp; launch baseline uses Genesis. Present results separately for every horizon.

funding_models.upgrade_funding: Claimed harvest balances, with sufficient ETH for wallet-paid costs if applicable.
Harvests plus explicitly budgeted external funds.

wallet_policy.baseline: Keep plots in their original wallets unless consolidation improves the modeled outcome.
wallet_policy.consolidation_requirement: Compare transfer and replanting costs against estimated future savings. Preserve per-wallet feasibility. User is willing to consolidate if cheaper.
wallet_policy.execution_scope: Only individually human-approved supported actions. Swaps and asset transfers remain manual.

fees.user_expectation: Many operations, especially harvesting, may have no wallet-paid gas; Robinhood Chain is expected to be cheap.
fees.evidence: Almanac and reviewed source confirm zero harvest game fee and no CROP approval. Claims are on-chain transactions; network sponsorship and eventual wallet-paid costs remain unverified.
fees.unknown_cost_policy: Unknown is not zero. Label sponsored/zero-cost assumptions explicitly.

initial_interaction: Public monitoring remains available without wallet connection. User now requests active guided planning and individually human-approved MetaMask actions.
milestone: Shared planning engine, dashboard, Tampermonkey panel and read-only CLI implemented, with opt-in guided planning and one-at-a-time human-approved planting, upgrades and claims. No real transactions were sent during development.

profit_policy.baseline: Compare against planting and making no upgrades; allow choosing no additional investment.
profit_policy.optimization_claim: Report the best evaluated strategy under named assumptions; do not claim a guaranteed future maximum.
profit_policy.capital: External purchases and deposits are not income; count acquisition and operation costs without double-counting them.
profit_policy.eth_reporting: Separate realized ETH profit from estimated token/NFT liquidation value.
profit_policy.crop_reporting: Separate earned CROP, CROP spent, purchased CROP, pending CROP, and liquid balance.
profit_policy.terminal_nft_value: Require an explicit estimate; burned upgrade cost is not a resale-value guarantee.
profit_policy.missing_inputs: Return unavailable/required inputs instead of fabricating estimates.

implementation.strategy_search: Complete affordable paths under multiple ranking policies and 25/50/100% extra-budget ceilings; best evaluated candidate, not a global guarantee.
implementation.pre_mint: Wallet-free public season observations, cached evidence and clearly hypothetical allocation estimates. Never populate owned plots from expected counts.
implementation.guided_planning: Optional current-time plan across both wallets, selected horizon/funding/objective; whole-portfolio marginal diagnostics, rare-next-step comparison, delayed planting opportunity cost and stress reruns of selected policy.
implementation.execution: Shared executor for dashboard/userscript; public preparation, exact approvals, single transaction submissions only on explicit human action, durable pending lock and matching receipt reconciliation.
implementation.source_review: Six verified-source/runtime matches archived in contract-review.md. Nominal projection still omits exact accumulator rounding and Granary depletion.

rule_authority.scope: Gameplay planning; supporting pages and client descriptions do not override it.
rule_authority.limits: Do not invent unspecified mechanics or extend the targeted six-contract source review into a blanket security or behavior guarantee. Record verified findings and Almanac conflicts explicitly.

funding_target.authority: User attempted to fund each wallet at least USD 100; September 7, 2026
funding_target.valuation: Native ETH on Robinhood Chain × timestamped indicative ETH/USD; does not establish all-in planting funding.

initial_interaction_history: Read-only monitoring and advisory recommendations; user performs actions through MetaMask on the official site.

human_approval_execution.authority: Latest user request: automatically pull from wallets and take action with human approval, with an active guided plan to maximize profits. This supersedes the earlier read-only interaction scope.
human_approval_execution.user_control: Public reads and plan recalculation can be automatic when enabled. Preparing a draft is read-only; submission requires an explicit click and MetaMask approval for that one transaction.
human_approval_execution.follow_on_actions: An approved token allowance is not authorization to spend; prepare and approve the intended plant/upgrade separately after the allowance receipt.
human_approval_execution.credentials: Never request or persist seed phrases/private keys.
human_approval_execution.guards: Configured account/chain, current block, reviewed runtime and linked contracts, owner, costs, pauses, balances and allowances are checked; eth_call/gas estimate precede a short-lived draft. Pending or unknown broadcasts block another action until reconciled.
human_approval_execution.pre_genesis_policy: Keep the Almanac Genesis opening for planting/upgrades, clearly distinguish it from source contracts which have no such gate.
human_approval_execution.budget: The USD 100 per-wallet funding target does not establish an extra CROP investment cap.
